title: General Aptitude
authority: IIT Madras, Organizing Institute for GATE 2027

sections.name: Verbal Aptitude
scope: Basic English grammar: tenses, articles, adjectives, prepositions, conjunctions, verb-noun agreement and other parts of speech
Basic vocabulary: words, idioms and phrases in context

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
scope: Data interpretation using graphs, 2D and 3D plots, maps and tables
Ratios, percentages, powers, exponents and logarithms

sections.name: Spatial Aptitude
scope: Translation, rotation, scaling and mirroring of shapes
Patterns in two and three dimensions
